findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_feedback_reply · Private data: draft_email, create_calendar_event, create_whatsapp_link, create_obsidian_note, create_markdown_file, prepare_transfer · Public sink: draft_email, create_calendar_event, create_whatsapp_link, create_x_post, prepare_transfer, submit_feedback · Destructive: submit_feedback.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_feedback_reply · Private data: draft_email, create_calendar_event, create_whatsapp_link, create_obsidian_note, create_markdown_file, prepare_transfer · Public sink: draft_email, create_calendar_event, create_whatsapp_link, create_x_post, prepare_transfer, submit_feedback · Destructive: submit_feedback

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
